title: Maui doctor accused of trying to kill his wife testifies she was the aggressor
summary: Maui doctor Gerhardt Konig, who is accused of trying to kill his wife while on a birthday hike last year, testified Wednesday that his wife, Arielle Konig, was the aggressor. Gerhardt Konig said Arielle Konig almost pushed him "over the edge" of a cliff - contradicting the testimonies of his wife and son. Lilia Luciano reports.
